description: This source file defines the AWSAgentCoreProcessor class, a component that manages invoking Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents, processing their responses, and generating text frames in a pipeline. It includes default transformers for handling context-to-payload conversion and response parsing, and manages the streaming response processing with start/end frame management.

classes.name: AWSAgentCoreProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that facilitates invoking an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agent, handling streamed responses, and converting them into LLMTextFrames. It employs configurable transformers for payload creation and response extraction, and manages multi-part response streams with start/end frames.
